_comment: The Expanse — Earth / United Nations Navy. Grounded from refs/unn/NOTES.md. ROYAL/NAVY blue primary, deliberately deeper/more saturated than Roci's cyan (faction separation). DESIGN INTENT (user-confirmed): UNN is deliberately CLUNKY / BORING / INSTITUTIONAL / UTILITARIAN — the 'boring competent bureaucracy' register. Do NOT make it slick like roci/belter. Flat plain panels, no glow, no grit, no angular flourish — the dull weight of the establishment. Red = incoming-threat accent, green = diplomatic. Slightly cooler/architectural surface (Earth has buildings). Showrunner banned flashing-text-box excess. layout=pack.

data._comment: Royal→light-blue ladder, institutional. System amber[4]/red[5] stay rare signals.

type._comment: Plain, gov/corporate register (no command-line or grit). Saira (DIN-adjacent, bundled) with a plain-sans fallback; a plain mono. No D-DIN (that's MCRN).
type.head: "Saira", "Arial", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
